Operating segments are defined as components of an enterprise for which discrete financial information is available that is evaluated regularly by the chief operating decision maker, in deciding how to allocate resources and assessing performance. The Group business comprises of Broking and other related activities,Financing activities,Asset Management and Advisory activities and Real estate development activities.
